checks.evidence: Solid route obstacle blocks initial sight.

checks.name: validated-result-journal
checks.evidence: The live log records successful deterministic API outcomes.

checks.name: repeatable-decision-and-action-trace
checks.evidence: Same scene reset reproduces the same goal/action/result/failure events at the same fixed ticks.

checks.name: layout-changes-goal
checks.evidence: Moving amber outside perception changes the first choice to blue without a sequence edit.

checks.name: permission-revocation-nonmutating
checks.evidence: Revoked permission rejects pickup after navigation/gesture without acquiring the object.

checks.name: failure-has-fallback
checks.evidence: Failure and deterministic retry/goal fallback are recorded.

checks.name: alternate-goal-after-failure
checks.evidence: After denied pickup, the inhabitant selects another perceived item and completes a delivery.

checks.name: full-destination-retains-cargo
checks.evidence: Live capacity rejection preserves owned carried cargo.

checks.name: delivery-fallback-chooses-another-depot
checks.evidence: A newly full depot is rejected and another perceived empty depot receives the retained cargo.

checks.name: offline-no-goal-fallback
checks.evidence: No permitted goal produces a safe wait/resense state with no network or LLM dependency.

checks.name: control-fixture-carrying-with-goal
checks.evidence: Control tests begin with a real carried item and active delivery goal.

checks.name: autonomous-mode-explicit
checks.evidence: Default mode follows the autonomous NPC.

checks.name: movement-does-not-possess
checks.evidence: W leaves ownership with autonomy.

checks.name: R-pauses-autonomy
checks.evidence: Actual R key event stops autonomous translation without clearing cargo or goal.

checks.name: R-resumes-autonomy
checks.evidence: Second R event resumes the existing route.

checks.name: spectator-camera-and-autonomous-NPC
checks.evidence: F selects free spectator; W moves its camera while the same NPC continues autonomous movement.

checks.name: explicit-possession-preserves-context
checks.evidence: Tab possesses the same body with cargo, goal context and prior decision events intact.

checks.name: arrow-and-WASD-equivalent-in-possession
checks.evidence: Up arrow and W produce equivalent movement through the actual input adapter and motor.

checks.name: right-mouse-look
checks.evidence: Actual right-button and delta events rotate the view.

checks.name: right-mouse-release
checks.evidence: Releasing right mouse ends look capture.

checks.name: P-is-true-simulation-pause
checks.evidence: P opens the menu and freezes fixed ticks, body translation and animated pose.

checks.name: controls-page-readable-guide
checks.evidence: Keyboard navigation opens the real Controls page with possession, movement, autonomy and Escape guidance.

checks.name: Escape-submenu-goes-back
checks.evidence: Escape closes the submenu first; simulation remains paused.

checks.name: Escape-root-resumes
checks.evidence: Escape from the root menu resumes the same world.

checks.name: graphics-page
checks.evidence: Keyboard navigation reaches Graphics.

checks.name: fullscreen-applied-in-player
checks.evidence: Menu invokes the existing display controller; actual Screen mode=Windowed 1600x900

checks.name: windowed-restored-in-player
checks.evidence: Second menu display toggle restores the observed original mode and dimensions.

checks.name: display-preserves-NPC-world-state
checks.evidence: Both display transitions preserve identity, cargo, goal, decision history and paused simulation ticks.

checks.name: P-resumes-from-submenu
checks.evidence: P resumes directly from Graphics.

checks.name: F11-direct-fullscreen
checks.evidence: Actual F11 event changes display from gameplay, temporarily freezes the body and restores the previous running state.

checks.name: F11-restores-window-and-context
checks.evidence: Second F11 restores original dimensions and preserves identity, cargo, goal, log, position and pause state.

checks.name: release-possession-resumes-same-NPC
checks.evidence: Tab releases the same NPC, retains context, replans from its current position and resumes autonomy.

checks.name: autonomy-moves-after-release
checks.evidence: The retained NPC actually continues its delivery route after release.

checks.name: Escape-outside-menu-pauses-and-releases
checks.evidence: Outside menus, Escape pauses the world and releases look capture.

checks.name: exit-action-reaches-player-handler
checks.evidence: Exit preview is selected through actual key events. Smoke records this request before its final Application.Quit; production exits immediately.

checks.name: hybrid-disabled-by-default
checks.evidence: All preceding deterministic baseline and control checks executed with optional thoughts off and no provider requests.

checks.name: local-thoughts-menu-default-off
checks.evidence: Actual keyboard events open Controls > Local thoughts; configured provider is still off.

checks.name: local-thoughts-explicit-menu-opt-in
checks.evidence: The menu enables configured local thoughts explicitly; paused simulation launches no request.

checks.name: provider-does-not-mutate-world
checks.evidence: Provider reply alone cannot navigate, pickup, deliver or mutate inventory; the decision boundary must consume and validate it.

checks.name: fake-provider-selects-eligible-nonnearest-goal
checks.evidence: A deterministic fake provider selects blue instead of nearest amber; fresh eligibility validation admits only the high-level goal.

checks.name: hybrid-HUD-source-and-text
checks.evidence: The live HUD distinguishes the fake source and exposes advisory plan, fictional dialogue and generated reflection.

checks.name: fake-goal-executes-through-validated-actions
checks.evidence: Actual humanoid navigates, carries blue and delivers using the unchanged deterministic NpcActionApi.

checks.name: invalid-live-proposal-falls-back
checks.evidence: Proposed denied target is rejected without pickup; deterministic policy selects amber immediately.

checks.name: actual-unavailable-endpoint-fallback
checks.evidence: Actual closed-loopback adapter outcome=timeout; goal=amber. An unavailable endpoint may fail immediately or hit the bounded deadline; both resume deterministic choice.

checks.name: unavailable-circuit-prevents-repeated-stalls
checks.evidence: The first unavailable/timeout reply disables optional thoughts until explicit retry, so later goals do not repeatedly wait for the service.

checks.name: offline-fallback-still-delivers
checks.evidence: The unavailable model never prevents the actual deterministic delivery flow.

checks.name: runtime-timeout-fallback
checks.evidence: A noncooperative delayed provider times out and deterministic choice resumes.

checks.name: runtime-late-reply-discarded
checks.evidence: Late blue proposal cannot replace the fallback amber goal or acquire cargo.

checks.name: pause-cancels-pending-proposal
checks.evidence: Opening P/options cancels the pending request immediately and preserves the same paused actor.

checks.name: cancelled-reply-cannot-mutate-paused-world
checks.evidence: A reply after cancellation cannot affect the paused world.

checks.name: disable-resumes-deterministic-goal
checks.evidence: Disabling thoughts resumes deterministic selection on the same NPC.

checks.name: real-probe-bounded-completion
checks.evidence: One actual local provider attempt completes or times out within the bounded probe window.

checks.name: real-provider-cannot-mutate-world
checks.evidence: A completed HTTP/model reply has not yet passed the deterministic goal boundary and cannot touch the world.

checks.name: real-probe-one-audited-attempt
checks.evidence: Exactly one local provider attempt was consumed and audited.

checks.name: real-probe-deterministic-execution-or-fallback
checks.evidence: Actual deterministic pickup/delivery completed after the one proposal. Outcome=timeout; measured=5000ms.

checks.name: no-runtime-errors
checks.evidence: No player error/assert/exception.
